name: SEQ-101
description: Discharge-train start/stop sequence as an SFC chart. One SFC_CHART block owns the whole procedure; the cmd_start/cmd_stop DIs declare the operator command tags for the faceplate and the tag database.

config.CHART: {"steps": [{"id": "s_idle", "name": "IDLE", "description": "Everything safe: valve shut, drive off", "initial": true, "x": 0.0, "y": 0.0, "actions": [{"id": "a_xv0", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('XV-101.cmd_open', 0)", "description": "Discharge valve closed"}, {"id": "a_xvc0", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('XV-101.cmd_close', 0)", "description": "Clear the close request"}, {"id": "a_mtr0", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('MTR-101.cmd_start', 0)", "description": "No start request"}, {"id": "a_stp0", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('MTR-101.cmd_stop', 0)", "description": "Clear the stop request"}, {"id": "a_spd0", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('VFD-101.speed_sp', 0.0)", "description": "Zero speed demand"}]}, {"id": "s_open", "name": "OPEN_PATH", "description": "Open the discharge valve", "initial": false, "x": 0.0, "y": 0.0, "actions": [{"id": "a_xv1", "name": "", "description": "", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('XV-101.cmd_open', 1)"}]}, {"id": "s_drive", "name": "START_DRIVE", "description": "Valve proven open - start the motor", "initial": false, "x": 0.0, "y": 0.0, "actions": [{"id": "a_xv1b", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('XV-101.cmd_open', 1)", "description": "Hold the path open"}, {"id": "a_spdmin", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('VFD-101.speed_sp', 10.0)", "description": "Minimum reference \u2014 MTR-101 start permissive needs speed_ref > 5%"}, {"id": "a_mtr1", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('MTR-101.cmd_start', 1)", "description": "Start the drive"}]}, {"id": "s_ramp", "name": "RAMP_TO_SPEED", "description": "Ramp the VFD setpoint at 8 %/s to 55 %", "initial": false, "x": 0.0, "y": 0.0, "actions": [{"id": "a_xv1c", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('XV-101.cmd_open', 1)", "description": "Hold the path open"}, {"id": "a_mtr1b", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('MTR-101.cmd_start', 1)", "description": "Hold the run request"}, {"id": "a_rampspd", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('VFD-101.speed_sp', min(55.0, max(10.0, step_time * 8.0)))", "description": "Ramp 8 %/s from the 10% floor to 55%"}]}, {"id": "s_run", "name": "RUNNING", "description": "At speed - hold the train", "initial": false, "x": 0.0, "y": 0.0, "actions": [{"id": "a_xv4", "name": "", "description": "", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('XV-101.cmd_open', 1)"}, {"id": "a_mtr3", "name": "", "description": "", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('MTR-101.cmd_start', 1)"}, {"id": "a_spd", "name": "", "description": "", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('VFD-101.speed_sp', 55.0)"}]}, {"id": "s_stop", "name": "STOPPING", "description": "Drive off, valve open until proven stopped", "initial": false, "x": 0.0, "y": 0.0, "actions": [{"id": "a_xv1d", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('XV-101.cmd_open', 1)", "description": "Path stays open while coasting"}, {"id": "a_mtr0b", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('MTR-101.cmd_start', 0)", "description": "Drop the run request"}, {"id": "a_stp1", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('MTR-101.cmd_stop', 1)", "description": "DEVCTL latches running \u2014 it stops on STOP_CMD, not on START_CMD falling"}, {"id": "a_spd0b", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('VFD-101.speed_sp', 0.0)", "description": "Speed demand to zero"}]}, {"id": "s_close", "name": "CLOSE_PATH", "description": "Close the valve behind the stopped train", "initial": false, "x": 0.0, "y": 0.0, "actions": [{"id": "a_xv0b", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('XV-101.cmd_open', 0)", "description": "Drop the open request"}, {"id": "a_xvc1", "qualifier": "N", "expression": "set_tag('XV-101.cmd_close', 1)", "description": "XV-101 DEVCTL latches \u2014 it closes on cmd_close, not on cmd_open falling"}]}], "transitions": [{"id": "t_start", "name": "Start requested", "description": "", "condition": "tag('SEQ-101.cmd_start', 0) == 1", "source": "s_idle", "target": "s_open"}, {"id": "t_zso", "name": "Valve proven open", "description": "", "condition": "tag('XV-101.ZSO', 0) == 1", "source": "s_open", "target": "s_drive"}, {"id": "t_runfb", "name": "Motor running", "description": "", "condition": "tag('MTR-101.run_fb', 0) == 1", "source": "s_drive", "target": "s_ramp"}, {"id": "t_atspeed", "name": "At operating speed", "description": "", "condition": "tag('VFD-101.speed_pv', 0.0) >= 50.0", "source": "s_ramp", "target": "s_run"}, {"id": "t_stop", "name": "Stop requested", "description": "", "condition": "tag('SEQ-101.cmd_stop', 0) == 1", "source": "s_run", "target": "s_stop"}, {"id": "t_stopped", "name": "Motor proven stopped", "description": "", "condition": "tag('MTR-101.run_fb', 1) == 0", "source": "s_stop", "target": "s_close"}, {"id": "t_closed", "name": "Valve proven closed", "description": "", "condition": "tag('XV-101.ZSC', 0) == 1", "source": "s_close", "target": "s_idle"}]}
